title: promotions.release
description: The orders checkout hook, release step (a failed checkout, a cancelled order, an orphan). Output: {ok: true, status: 'released' | 'expired' | 'committed' | 'none'}. A reserved attempt is released for any reason; only reason cancelled undoes a committed attempt (when RETURN_USAGE_ON_RELEASE) — checkout_failed / orphaned on a committed attempt is a no-op answering ok. Idempotent on attempt_key.

user_id.description: The account id; null for a guest (actor_id names the guest).

actor_id.description: The acting account id (a guest's own id, or the account), always sent by orders that know it; user_id stays null for a guest. Owner of this brick's rows; absent from older orders payloads.
